high_level_description: This image is a Google Doodle celebrating the life of Jigoro Kano, the founder of judo. The central figure is a portrait of Kano, depicted in traditional Japanese attire, which includes a dark-colored kimono with a white inner layer and a white obi (sash) tied at the waist. His expression is serious and contemplative. The background of the portrait is divided into four smaller panels, each depicting different aspects of Kano's life and contributions to judo: Top Left Panel: This panel shows two individuals practicing judo techniques on a mat.
